574-4488-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a 4/4 green Beast creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-4488-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

483-1981-2415-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
483-1981-2415-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4881-6471-6909.manaNeeded: {5}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6471-6909.description:
Cast Will of the Temur by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

4050-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4050-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Repeat from step 1.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2464-2624-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-2624-3249--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-2624-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, God-Eternal Oketra triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-4365-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

46-7683.notablePrerequisites: You have another instant or sorcery card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
46-7683.description:
Cast any other instant or sorcery by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Cooperate from your graveyard by paying its mana cost, targeting the instant or sorcery cast in step 1.
Cooperate's storm ability triggers, creating at least one copy of Cooperate targeting the original Cooperate.
Resolve a copy of Cooperate, copying Cooperate targeting the original Cooperate.
Repeat step 4.

864-1987-3110.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
864-1987-3110.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
864-1987-3110.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

3375-3532-5078-7656.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3375-3532-5078-7656.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

240-5686-5929.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-5686-5929.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

2906-4907-5315-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
2906-4907-5315-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1687-2921-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3028-3129-5702.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3028-3129-5702.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Vital Force
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1329-1492-3562.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-3562.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Sky Hussar.
When Sky Hussar enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1170-1329-4068-4211.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
1170-1329-4068-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1879-4708.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Dark Sphere from your graveyard.
Cast Dark Sphere by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

304-1978-4131.description:
Animate Basalt Monolith using Tough Cookie.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat from step 2.

1640-2613-4083.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Spiteful Sliver.
Spiteful Sliver is indestructible.
1640-2613-4083.description:
Deal damage to Spiteful Sliver.
Spiteful Sliver and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Spiteful Sliver trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Spiteful Sliver instead of you due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-1753-2457-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

222-527-997-4785.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-997-4785.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2726-2743-3657.description:
Cast Biovisionary by paying {1}{G}{U}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Biovisionary spell.
Resolve both Biovisionary spells.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning the nontoken Biovisionary from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time, and then repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary you control triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

880-2757-6529.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

1-392-2428-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-392-2428-6282.description:
Activate Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty ability.
Repeat.

751-2048-3390-6075.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn.
You have no other cards in your library with a mana value of 0.
751-2048-3390-6075.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake's cascade ability from Abaddon the Despoiler triggers, causing you to cast Lotus Bloom from your library since it is the only valid card to cast.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself to your hand.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Lotus Bloom from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

1413-2178-5147.notablePrerequisites:
Thraben Doomsayer does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Thraben Doomsayer.
1413-2178-5147.description:
Activate Thraben Doomsayer by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Human creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Human.
When the Human dies, Thraben Doomsayer triggers, untapping Thraben Doomsayer.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-5776-5777.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding {C}{C}.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.
2034-5776-5777.notes: If you have mana available, you may instead sacrifice the creatures using Camellia's ability.

1743-2060-3398-4613.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least seven Merfolk.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger.
1743-2060-3398-4613.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Hakbal of the Surging Soul's first ability triggers, causing you to reveal the top card of your library, put a +1/+1 counter on each Merfolk you control and putting the card back on top of your library.
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Activate seven Merfolk you control using Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from each of them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
If you control eight or more Merfolk, this combo nets infinite colored mana and +1/+1 counters on Merfolk you control.

140-2749-3245.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

7-708-2034-2500-2931.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with a +1/+1 counter on them.
7-708-2034-2500-2931.description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Myth Unbound until end of turn.
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Faceless One, adding {C}{C}.
Choose to return Faceless One to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.

2174-3078-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Juniper Order Druid.
2174-3078-4222.description:
Activate Soldevi Excavations by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Soldevi Excavations.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
